observations: Multiple projectors stacked on metal shelves, mostly wrapped in plastic.
Brands visible: EPSON (photo 0, photo 1), NEC (photo 2), and possibly others like BenQ (photo 0, top row, partially visible).
Projectors vary in design: some are white, some silver, one is orange (photo 0, bottom right).
All projectors appear to be in sealed plastic wrap, suggesting they are new or unused.
Shelves are dusty and show signs of wear; environment looks like a storage or warehouse space.
Watermark 'MEGAPROJECTORS POSTED ON Jiji' is present on all photos.
No power cords, remote controls, or boxes are visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Large stock of Projector for sale
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows multiple projectors stacked on shelves, indicating a large quantity.

risks.risk: Projectors may be refurbished or used despite appearing sealed
risks.proof: Close-up of the plastic wrap showing signs of tampering or resealing, or a shot of the projector's serial number and condition inside the packaging.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly refurbished, which reduces value

risks.risk: Projectors may be missing accessories (cables, remotes, power adapters)
risks.proof: Photo showing the contents of a single unit's packaging, including all accessories.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing accessories, which reduces value

risks.risk: Projectors may be counterfeit or non-genuine (especially for brands like EPSON, NEC)
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the brand logo and model number on the projector body, and a shot of the serial number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified authenticity, which reduces value

risks.risk: Projectors may be damaged or non-functional despite being sealed
risks.proof: Video or photo of the projector being powered on and projecting an image.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, which reduces value

proof_requests: Close-up of the brand and model name on a single projector (preferably EPSON or NEC).
Photo of the inside of a sealed projector box showing accessories and serial number.
Video or photo of a projector being turned on and projecting an image.
Photo of the plastic wrap showing whether it is factory-sealed or resealed.
response.reason: While the photos show a large stock of projectors, the exact brands and models are not clearly readable, and critical risks like authenticity, functionality, and completeness of accessories cannot be verified remotely. Without proof of these, the item cannot be priced accurately.
